text: 证监会期货监管司副司长王颖：截至2026年9月末，全市场有效客户达314.8万户。商品期货成交量已连续多年位居世界前列，市场深度和承载力持续增强。（中证金牛座）
text_en: Wang Ying, Deputy Director of the Futures Supervision Department of the CSRC: As of the end of September 2026, the number of effective clients in the entire market reached 3.148 million. Commodity futures trading volume has ranked among the world's top for many consecutive years, and market depth and capacity have continued to strengthen. (Zhongzheng Jinniu)
